semanticConditions: all prefix refs exact structural equality including tenant/game/generation/length
request.rules exactly equals prior.rules; request.t1.before exactly equals prior.after
started-initial only length0 and canonical actual start state; evaluated-prefix length>=1; locked-prefix never successful
newHistoryEntry is exactly the sole entry produced by shared ordinary T1 with local empty stack; no count/difference recomputation
nextPrefixRef copies all prior fields and increments only length by1 using bigint
T2 checks all end-related unchanged fields and cold stages/DRAW/lock consistency; unsupported evaluation never success
gameEnded false does not establish prior open; missing/unknown/unverified prior cannot authorize storage
actual saved rules deep equality, not only identifier equality; enforce DRAW01..04 correlations
scope is ordinary open series; contradictory terminal-like states are closed unsupported inputs, not a permanent rule forbidding approved resumed games
prefix generation is opaque D4, never parse it as recovery_generation or an integer
prior.t2 is validated semantically against prior.after and prior.rules, not just accepted by schema: no T2 envelope may be transplanted to another state/rules

legacy first-ball prior T2: require exact after inning1/top/S0/B1/out0/empty/battingOrder1/TBfalse/gameEndedfalse/score and all scoreboard zero, R7 orR9, cold empty, TB null, L null orR9L9; all declared basis fields match those rules and after

ordinary prior T2: require basis regulationInnings/configuredExtensionLimit/inning/half/tiebreakActive equal saved prior.rules/after; coldBranches count/order equals full evaluation of all configured stages at prior.after/current attack context, aggregate COLD07 only with zero matched terminal stages; DRAW07 iff Lnull else DRAW08 only before final bottom completion; priorOpen/halfCompleted/scoreUnchanged/outsUnchanged are not stand-alone authority proofs
legacy prior T2 transplantation and ordinary basis mismatch are T2_NOT_EVALUATED even when prefixRef/rules/before-to-after pairwise equal

every successful test compares the complete assembled response exactly: mathematical expected envelope from immutable case + explicitly fixed after/T2/ref/history values; no field omission or partial-match success
errorOrder: prefix/rules/prior correspondence or prior lock -> T2_NOT_EVALUATED
shared ordinary T1 rejection -> existing T1 error
mutationRequirements: missing/extra keys at every new object
uppercase/noncanonical UUID; empty/over128 opaque D4; leading-zero/signed/float prefix length
historyContext 0 or 2 entries must never become 1 successful entry
S2 foul empty difference still exactly1 entry
finite page/checkpoint missing authority must fail service admission; pure math does not certify it
caseComparison: All success and failure responses are compared exactly using expected.response. Success responses are statically assembled from existing mathematical envelopes and explicit fixed candidate after/T2/ref/history values; reference expectations are not generated by the implementation under test. No partial match or omitted fields.

refSemantics.generation: 記録世代D4のopaque string（1..128文字）。正整数ではなく、recovery_generationとも別。サービスは実記録世代へ束縛する。
refSemantics.length: ordinary-only確認済prefixに含まれる支持37投球entryの確定水位。全操作履歴長・D1/D2・PlayRow番号ではない。旧初球ordinary投球を含む場合は確認済原本から数える。取消/訂正/再開等を含む一般履歴refへ拡張していない。
refSemantics.authority: 同game/tenant/generation/prefix水位の真正checkpointにafter/T2/保存rules実内容を束縛する。数学のequal/refshapeだけで実権限成立とはしない。
refSemantics.increment: 通常37の成功1件だけでlength n->n+1。他のref値は完全不変。再送は同n要求/同結果を同期境界が再掲し数学の再評価回数で水位を増やさない。
